prompts.A: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original Nunti companion concept A, a living tiny sea-glass creature born from a specific coastal journey, for a premium collectible avatar app. The attached image is the STRUCTURAL ROUTE reference only, not a logo or line to print on a belly. Same journey: destination Anmok beach in Gangneung, explicit traits calm blue waves, softly rounded sea glass, coffee aroma; purpose a quiet weekend rest. Visually translate the route's sequence of three gentle bends into a compact rounded body flow, a little rolled wave-tail and a softly folded top crest. The route's starting bend becomes the curled tail and the endpoint becomes the little crest. Make the relationship legible in the silhouette itself, not by adding a necklace or unrelated accessory. Very cute and irresistibly tactile, tiny companion rather than a large ornate toy: generous round cheeks, two small widely spaced warm dark eyes with pinpoint catchlights, tiny resting mouth, short soft flippers and little feet, slight curious head tilt. Chunky compact palm-size proportions, wide rounded belly, no long thin snake or noodle. Material is expertly sculpted translucent milky aquamarine glass with pearlescent inner depth, soft transmitted cyan, slightly frosted face patch so the expression reads, subtle warm caustic edges, delicate bubbles that don't crowd the body, satin-soft finish rather than wet plastic. One fine warm route-like inner filament may reinforce the external flow, but the silhouette carries the concept. High-end original character illustration with convincing 2.5D volume, sophisticated editorial toy art, warm studio key light, restrained highlights. Complete character centered, three-quarter front view, full silhouette with 12 percent empty margins, true transparent RGBA background. No text, no labels, no map, no frame, no pedestal, no logos. Do not imitate any existing franchise or artist. Output one polished final character image, not a sheet.
prompts.B: Use case: stylized-concept. One original tiny Nunti companion, a living premium translucent 2.5D collectible. Same confirmed fictional test journey: Gangneung Anmok beach; blue waves, softly rounded sea glass and coffee aroma; a quiet weekend rest. Attached Image 1 is a STRUCTURAL ROUTE reference, not an edit target and not a symbol to stamp on a belly. The route's major bend sequence should have a readable structural relationship to the body. Full character alone, three-quarter front view, centered with generous transparent margins, true alpha PNG. No text, labels, frame, pedestal, map screenshot, brand logos or imitation of any existing franchise. Very cute compact palm-size anatomy, warm dark expressive eyes, tiny mouth, tactile volume, careful face readability, soft warm studio light and restrained highlights. Not a long thin snake, not a random hat/accessory change. Concept B: a little coastal tide spirit whose actual body is formed by two broad softly overlapping translucent wave-lobes, like a gently folded sea-glass shell protecting a small cream-colored face. The source route's lower bend rolls into the left lobe, middle direction change creates the opening around the face, and the upper endpoint softly folds into the right crest. Two broad rounded body lobes are the main silhouette, not ears glued onto an oval blob. Tiny little feet peeking out, two short flippers that rest against the body, a quietly inquisitive expression. Thick opalescent seafoam and soft sky-blue glass, fine inner tide layers with visible depth and smooth frosted edges. Cozy, delicate and collectible, balanced original character sculpture, no literal seashell hat or toy capsule.
